_doc: Hand review of the rule classifier of semantics/tools/trace_requirements.py (basis rule:<id>). Sample: Python random.Random(20261114).sample(pool, 80), pool = the requirements whose bases include a rule: basis, sorted by id. Verdict on the rule-derived targets only (finding, kind, repairs and explicit bases are not under review): agree = every rule target fits the statement; partly = at least one fits and at least one does not or fits only loosely; disagree = none fits. Judged by the semantics lane (one reviewer, reading the statement text; Notes and Source consulted where the text was unclear); not an independent review. Round 1 precision met the bar (disagree 3/80); its three systematic false-positive patterns were still fixed (read-purity 'reads only' read as scope; 'recorded graph' as a ledger record; redaction verbs and cost statements as removal reach; 'schema 2' as a version gate), the trace regenerated and the same-seed sample drawn again (round 2; 39 of its 80 items were also in round 1 with unchanged rule targets, whose round-1 verdicts are reused). trace.json corresponds to round 2.
